description: WSCC Based Grid Aware Dataset of Electric Vehicle Charging Transcations is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors V Kethareswaran, Sanjay Moulik. A novel grid-aware data set of EV charging sessions for V2G simulation and research. The data set presented in this paper is derived from existing public real world data sets of Palo Alto City EVCS Data and Boulder City EVCS Data which have been integrated and restructured based on commonalities in grid structure ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 17993950 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
